title: Long term names wrap in the dropdown and on the customer card
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has two terms of its own with 31-character names: one the default, one switched off but held by a customer.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A} has a 31-character name and is the default; its own term {Term-B} also has a 31-character name, is deactivated and is held by customer {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-15 Long Default A, {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-15 Long Inactv BB and {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-15 Customer.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
  2. Open Edit Customer.
  3. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the card shows the whole of "{Term-B} (Inactive)", wrapping if needed; nothing is cut off.
  • Step 2: the selected value shows the whole name and "(Inactive)".
  • Step 3: {Term-A} shows in full followed by its "Default" tag, and "{Term-B} (Inactive)" shows in full; long names wrap.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R14: “Term names are never cut off in the Credit Terms dropdown or on the customer card, including with "(Inactive)" or the "Default" tag; long names wrap.”
